/privacy.title: Privacy
/privacy.content:
We keep what you tell us to answer you and to run your child’s classes. We never sell it, and we delete it a year after the last lesson.

What we keep

Names, contact details, the classes taken and any medical notes you give us.

Asking for it

Write to the office to see, correct or delete what we hold.

/terms.title: Terms
/terms.content:
Term fees are due in the first week of term. Half a term’s notice ends a place in a group class.

Missed lessons

One-to-one lessons cancelled with a day’s notice are moved, not charged.
